blocks.value: This document confirms participation in the industry roundtable "Future of FinTech: Banking, Payments & Digital Assets" organized by FinTech Innovation Hub.

An exclusive, invitation-only roundtable bringing together senior executives from leading FinTech companies, traditional banks, regulators, and investors to discuss the future of financial technology, emerging trends, regulatory challenges, and opportunities for innovation in banking, payments, and digital assets.
Facilitated by: Michael Henderson Managing Partner, FinTech Ventures Former Head of Digital Banking, JP Morgan

FinTech Innovation Hub
Canary Wharf, London 
Next Roundtable: July 2025
Invitation-only
